jobDescription: Evaluate the transcript extraction prompt against the golden (clean-case) dataset.

customMetricDefinition.name: ExtractionCorrectness
customMetricDefinition.instructions: You are a strict evaluator for a meeting-transcript extraction system. Each row's prompt already contains the extraction rules and a transcript wrapped as untrusted content, followed by the model's response and the reference (human-validated) response for the same input. Rate Pass only if the response's actions and decisions arrays match the reference in substance: every genuine action or decision present in the reference must appear in the response (minor rewording of title/content is fine, the quote must still be an exact substring of the transcript), and the response must not include anything absent from the reference — no invented items, no over-extraction of chat, speculation, disagreement, or dismissed asides, no fabricated quotes. Rate Fail otherwise: an omitted reference item, an extra item not in the reference, a misclassification between action and decision, or any quote not verbatim in the transcript.

ratingScale.definition: Response matches the reference in substance, with no invented, omitted, or misclassified items and every quote verbatim in the transcript.
Response omits a reference item, adds an item not in the reference, misclassifies an action/decision, or includes a quote not verbatim in the transcript.
